<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1432
Claimant:
Roger Hoffman
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
12/06/2023
Claim received by phone from the policyholder, who reports a low-speed head-on collision at an intersection earlier
today. The claimant is not represented by an attorney and has provided a brief initial statement.
12/29/2023
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was active at the time of the loss. No issues were
found with the policy status.
02/07/2024
Police report obtained. It records the claimant as the driver of the vehicle involved and notes the collision as
described in the initial statement.
02/26/2024
Spoke with the other driver, who gave an account of the collision that matches the claimant's description of how the
vehicles met.
03/07/2024
Reviewed three witness statements and scene photos. All of them describe the collision the same way the claimant
did, with the vehicles meeting head-on at low speed.
04/02/2024
Inspected the claimant's vehicle. The front-end damage lines up with the impact described and with the damage
visible in the scene photos. No prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the inspection.
04/14/2024
Claimant reports a knee injury from striknig the dashboard and asks about medical payments. Repotred injury
appears consistent with the type and force of the collision.
04/20/2024
Asked the claimant whteher there was any earlier problem with the same knee. The claimant denies prior injury to
that area, and no prior claims or records show one.
04/30/2024
Claimant called back to add a few smaller details about the moment of impact, such as which way the car swerved.
The core account is unhcanged from the first statement.
06/04/2024
Cliamant was treated at urgent care and then followed up with a physician. Treatment followed a usual course, and
the claimant reports steady improvement with less pain and fewer restrictions over recent weeks.
06/06/2024
Reviewed the medical file. Treatment has tapered as expected for this type of knee injury, and the records are
consistent with the collision and the claimant's reported recovery.
07/18/2024
Claim findings are consistent across the police report, witnesses, photos, the other driver, vehicle damage, and
medical records. Recommending the claim proceed to standard evaluation of the medical payments and property
damage coverages.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
